title: Exam 1 – Comprehensive Review (Ch.1–5)
notes: Homeostasis: negative vs positive feedback, components of control systems.
Anatomical planes, directional terms, body cavities, and serous membranes.
Atomic structure, bonding types (ionic, covalent, hydrogen), and water properties.
pH scale, buffers (bicarbonate), acids/bases/salts, and macromolecules overview.
Membrane structure and transport (simple/facilitated diffusion, osmosis, active transport).
Tonicity impacts on cells; vesicular transport types.
Organelle functions (ER, Golgi, lysosomes, peroxisomes, mitochondria, nucleus).
DNA→RNA→protein; mitosis stages and cell cycle control.
Tissues: epithelial classifications and specializations; cell junctions.
Connective tissue matrix/fibers; cartilage vs bone vs blood basics.
Muscle types (skeletal/cardiac/smooth) and nervous tissue basics.
Integument: epidermal layers, dermal layers, skin appendages, pigmentation.
Skin functions, wound healing, skin cancer ABCDE, and burns.
Integrative: structure-function relationships across levels of organization.
Common confusions: epithelial vs connective features; diffusion vs osmosis.
Application: predict outcomes of homeostatic disruptions (e.g., thermoregulation failure).
Clinical correlate: dehydration effects on blood osmolarity and tonicity.
Histology ID anchors: hallmark patterns for speed during exams.
Thermoregulation mechanisms via skin and vasculature.
Review week-by-week objectives as a final checklist.
